Problems we solve

  • Open opportunities go quiet for weeks without anyone noticing the record has gone stale.
  • Hiring signals and market evidence are not linked to matching prospects with a dated next action.
  • Won deals stall when scope, delivery owner and start date are not captured in a structured Delivery proposal.
What we offer

  • Opportunity Radar (Tested locally / walkthrough available): review dated hiring evidence from an approved source with ranking reason and source record, accept the signal and create a dated follow-up on a matching existing prospect.
  • Market Intelligence (UK Planning Data & Find a Tender) and Prospect Intelligence with explainable fit scoring and human review gates.
  • Automatic 14-day stale-opportunity flags in the Action Queue plus a Delivery proposal builder for recorded wins.

CAPABILITIES & WORKFLOWS

What Sales & Intelligence
lets your team do.

UK public-data search, Prospect Intelligence, Opportunity Radar follow-ups and Delivery proposals are Tested locally / walkthrough available; the first live Opportunity Radar feed and live email sending Require provider setup.

01

Market Intelligence: local UK activity

Enter a UK town/city or full Northern Ireland postcode, pick a 30- or 90-day lookback and radius (5–100 miles), plus an optional title keyword such as "expansion" or "refurbishment". Queries Planning Data (England participating authorities; capped at 100 applications, top 10 shown) and Find a Tender (scans up to 300 notices by wider delivery region with partial-coverage notices), linking directly to original public records and surfacing honest outage messages with zero AI credits.

02

Prospect Intelligence: CSV, filters & dated evidence

Import mapped CSVs (company,sector,location,source) and filter by sector, account owner, signal type (Vacancy, Expansion, Company announcement), evidence freshness (current/stale) and status (pending, accepted, research, rejected, revoked). Stores dated source links, Source fact, Sales interpretation and Suggested next step while scoring customer fit, evidence strength and contactability independently.

03

Opportunity Radar: hiring signal to prospect follow-up

In the locally tested Sales Growth workflow, an owner reviews dated hiring evidence, accepts the signal, and sets a due date on a matching existing prospect. Repeat submissions reuse the task. The first live feed requires setup.

04

Human decision & Action Queue assignment

Reviewers choose Accept and assign (owner + due date straight into the Sales Action Queue), Further research, Reject, or Revoke with reason. Stale evidence is blocked from acceptance until refreshed. Accepted prospects move cleanly into owned Action Queue tasks and CRM handover prep.

05

Sales workflow, quotes & structured JSON exports

Configurable 60/40 ICP fit scoring with hard exclusions, human-executed approved task sequences, one active tracked quote per prospect surfaced when overdue, and manual JSON exports for Business Delivery and Marketing outcomes. Automated enrichment, continuous scraping and live email sending remain Planned.

MARKET, PROSPECT & OPPORTUNITY RADAR

Local public data meets
human-reviewed evidence.

Combines live public UK planning and procurement sources with dated company evidence and Opportunity Radar hiring signals reviewed by your commercial team.

Public UK Sources

Market Intelligence: public UK data

  • Search any UK town/city or full Northern Ireland postcode with 5, 10, 25, 50 or 100-mile radius and 30/90-day lookback.
  • Planning Data (planning.data.gov.uk): covers participating local authorities in England (coverage varies by area; capped at first 100 matching records, displaying top 10).
  • Find a Tender (find-tender.service.gov.uk): scans up to 300 recent UK procurement notices matched by declared delivery region (wider area than radius; clearly flags partial results).
  • Displays direct links to source records and clear temporary outage messages.
Example · Leeds regional opportunity search

A regional sales lead enters "Leeds", selects a 25-mile radius, 90-day lookback and optional keyword "expansion" to spot nearby commercial developments on Planning Data and regional tenders on Find a Tender, clicking straight through to the original government records before deciding which accounts to target.

Human-Reviewed Evidence

Prospect Intelligence: sourced evidence reviewed by a person

  • Import mapped CSV columns: company, sector, location, source.
  • Filter pipeline by sector, account owner, signal type (Vacancy, Expansion, Company announcement), freshness (current/stale) and review status.
  • Independent assessment: Customer fit, Evidence strength and Contactability are scored separately — missing phone/email lowers contactability without hiding genuine fit.
  • Human review gate: Accept and assign (to Sales Action Queue), Further research, Reject, or Revoke later with a reason. Stale evidence cannot be accepted.
Example · Regional office expansion signal

An imported target ("Apex Commercial Group · Leeds · Office expansion") arrives with dated Source fact, Sales interpretation ("likely demand for commercial onboarding and regional supply support") and Suggested next step. The commercial lead sees High Fit even if phone details are still missing, selects Accept and assign, sets owner + due date, and creates an Action Queue task ready for CRM handover.

Tested locally / walkthrough available · First feed requires provider setup

Opportunity Radar: hiring evidence to dated prospect follow-up

  • Surfaces dated hiring evidence from an approved source alongside its ranking reason and original source record.
  • Owner reviews and accepts the signal before any follow-up is added to the matching existing prospect.
  • Repeat submissions reuse the existing follow-up task cleanly without creating duplicate actions.
  • Workflow is Tested locally / walkthrough available; connecting the first live hiring feed Requires provider setup.
Example · Accepted hiring signal linked to an existing prospect

An approved hiring signal arrives with a dated source record and ranking reason. The owner reviews the evidence, accepts the signal and sets a due date — creating a dated follow-up task directly on the matching existing prospect. Repeat submissions reuse the existing task rather than creating duplicates.
